*Note:* The reported memory leaks are temporarily suppressed in test_l1_dm_easy_mesh.cpp unit test file in Github repo

*Reason for memory leaks in various methods of the source code:*
 # create_autoconfig_renew_json_cmd - cJSON_Print() method allocates memory but
that memory is not freed with cJSON_free(). Currently cJSON_Delete(root) in code does NOT free 'tmp' variable
 # create_client_cap_query_json_cmd - same reason as create_autoconfig_renew_json_cmd method
 # create_client_cap_query_json_cmd - same reason as create_autoconfig_renew_json_cmd method
 # create_ap_cap_query_json_cmd - same reason as create_autoconfig_renew_json_cmd method
 # encode_config_reset - doesn't free net_obj using 'cJSON_Delete(net_obj);'
 # encode_config_test - same as encode_config_reset
 # decode_ap_cap_config - doesn't free parent_obj using 'cJSON_Delete(parent_obj)'
 # decode_config - allocated from 'cJSON_Parse' method which further calls cJSON_ParseWithLengthOpts(which calls malloc) called within decode_config_set_radio method. 'cJSON_Delete(parent_obj);' is not being called.
 # decode_config_set_policy - same as decode_config method
 # decode_client_cap_config - same as decode_config method
 # decode_config_set_ssid - same as decode_config method
 # put_sta_info - memory is not freed after '
hash_map_put(map, strdup(key), new dm_sta_t(sta_info));'
 # analyze_ap_cap_query - memory is allocated '
pcmd[0] = new em_cmd_ap_cap_report_t(evt->params,dm);' but never deallocated. This further calls 'em_cmd_t::init(dm_easy_mesh_t&)' ----> 'dm_easy_mesh_t::init()' ---> 'malloc'
 # 'operator =' - leak happens due to hash_map_put(m_sta_map, strdup(key), new dm_sta_t(*sta));

*Expected* *result:* No memory leaks should be reported

*Actual* *result:* Multiple methods in source code had memory leaks. 30+ unit tests report memory leaks
 
*Steps to Reproduce:*
 # Comment below lines of code in test_l1_dm_easy_mesh.cpp file under 'tests' folder:

{noformat}
extern "C" const char* __asan_default_options() {
    return "detect_leaks=0";
}{noformat}
 # Compile and generate 'onewifi_em_ctrl_test' target binary available in src/ctrl/Makefile.am
 #  Copy the onewifi_em_ctrl_test binary to /tmp location in BPI. Give execute permission to onewifi_em_ctrl_test binary.
{code:java}

root@Filogic-GW:/tmp#{code}
